HTTP.NAME: HTTP
HTTP.DESCRIPTION: Virtual HTTP inputs and outputs: poll web pages and APIs and read values from them, send HTTP commands to devices

ALLOW_LOCAL_HOST.NAME: Allow local host
ALLOW_LOCAL_HOST.DESCRIPTION: Allows requests to this server itself (localhost, 127.0.0.1). Off by default, so a URL cannot reach the services of the server. Devices in the local network are always allowed

TIMEOUT.NAME: Timeout [s]
TIMEOUT.DESCRIPTION: How long to wait for the answer

USERNAME.NAME: User
USERNAME.DESCRIPTION: User for HTTP basic authentication, empty = no authentication

PASSWORD.NAME: Password
PASSWORD.DESCRIPTION: Password for HTTP basic authentication, stored encrypted. Over http it is sent unencrypted, use https if the device supports it

INPUT.NAME: HTTP input
INPUT.DESCRIPTION: Polls a URL and reads values from the answer

URL.NAME: URL
URL.DESCRIPTION: Address that is requested, e.g. http://192.168.1.20/status. Only http and https, no user and password in the URL

POLL.NAME: Polling interval [s]
POLL.DESCRIPTION: How often the URL is requested (10 seconds to 7 days)

VALUE.NAME: Value
VALUE.DESCRIPTION: A number read from the answer

DIGITAL.NAME: Digital value
DIGITAL.DESCRIPTION: On or off read from the answer: true/false, on/off, yes/no or a number (0 = off)

TEXT.NAME: Text
TEXT.DESCRIPTION: A text read from the answer

MODE.NAME: Read with
MODE.DESCRIPTION: How the value is found in the answer

PATTERN.NAME: Pattern
PATTERN.DESCRIPTION: JSON path: $.sensors[0].temp. Regular expression: the first group is the value, e.g. temp=([0-9.]+). Command recognition: \iTemperature:\i\v reads the number after "Temperature:" (\i..\i search, \v number, \h hex number, \sN skip N characters, \1-\4 bytes)

OUTPUT.NAME: HTTP output
OUTPUT.DESCRIPTION: Sends HTTP commands to a device

ADDRESS.NAME: Address
ADDRESS.DESCRIPTION: Base address of the device, e.g. http://192.168.1.30. The commands are appended to it

STATUS.NAME: Status
STATUS.DESCRIPTION: HTTP status of the last command, 0 = no answer

COMMAND.NAME: Command
COMMAND.DESCRIPTION: Sends a request when the value changes. <v> is replaced by the value

DIGITAL_COMMAND.NAME: Digital command
DIGITAL_COMMAND.DESCRIPTION: Sends the ON command for true and the OFF command for false

COMMAND_ON.NAME: Command for ON
COMMAND_ON.DESCRIPTION: Path appended to the address (e.g. /relay/0?turn=on) or a full URL. <v> is the value, <v.1> the value with one decimal

BODY_ON.NAME: Body for ON
BODY_ON.DESCRIPTION: Body of a POST or PUT request, <v> is the value

COMMAND_OFF.NAME: Command for OFF
COMMAND_OFF.DESCRIPTION: Sent for 0 or false. Empty: a command sends the ON command with 0, a digital command sends nothing

BODY_OFF.NAME: Body for OFF
BODY_OFF.DESCRIPTION: Body of a POST or PUT request for 0 or false

CONTENT_TYPE.NAME: Content type
CONTENT_TYPE.DESCRIPTION: Content type of the body, e.g. application/json or text/plain
